text: Delivered in merge 40537b1 (branch commits e788ba6, 239f752). codec/ResultCodecs.scala (study-result@1, StudyResultCodec[K,U,P,S,D], score/difference codecs for the shipped types, StudyResultRegistry with typed Missing/DuplicateResultCodec) and ResultWire.scala (every error enum as kind tag plus operands, non-finite operands as explicit strings, 64-bit counts and digests as strings). Decode rebuilds only through design/plan reconstruct APIs that regroup pair rows per orientation and re-check every per-key denominator, report counts, provenance inputs digest against the input hash, density provenance steps against the described estimator, evaluation spec parameters against the described method, failure policy, layout and phases; no numerical work re-run. StudyScaleResult now carries typed StudyAnalyses. Frozen study-result-v1.json from the pinned plan and input re-encodes byte-identically on JVM and re-executes bit for bit on both platforms; StudyResultCodecLawSuite with five killed mutants under a Failed-only criterion; consumer registers a custom score codec (19/19 both runtimes). Fresh-context review: merge after fixes, all applied. Verified on merged main: root 2857, consumer green. Left: temporal and recording result archives (StudyFailure.Temporal refused with Unsupported until then), S5 manifests/payload refs, M4 source-linked diagnostics and projections.
